utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’d really appreciate any help this Saturday on the front porch. I’m a bit forgetful, but I’m doing my best to get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Oren — don’t worry, we’ll get it moving. I’m still looking for a few more handy helpers for Saturday, so if you think of anyone, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help this Saturday on the front porch for the repair drive. I’ll stop by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. See you Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help, and I’ll ask around for a few handy folks too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Sam — that’s a big help. I’ll reach out to Vik for Saturday on the front porch and keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — 10 a.m. on the front porch. I’ll check for a hammer and make sure the helpers know the time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. If you can, bring the hammer and maybe a pair of work gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks again, Uli — what time do you want me out there on Saturday? I can be there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — how about 9 a.m. on Saturday? I’d really appreciate you being there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Vik — thank you! I’ll put you down for Saturday on the front porch and let the others know we’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Happy to help — I’ll be on the front porch this Saturday for the repair drive and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help, and I’ll ask around for a couple more handy neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Sam — that’s a big help! I really appreciate you asking around, and I’ll keep you posted about the porch plans.
